whiteList.description: Normally leave empty. If not empty, only the devices named here are exposed (this plugin has one device, 'Robot Vacuum').

blackList.description: Normally leave empty. Devices named here are not exposed.

enableServerRvc.description: Enable the Robot Vacuum Cleaner in server mode (Apple Home will crash unless you use this mode!)

username.title: Wyze Username (E-Mail Address)
username.description: The e-mail address used for your Wyze account (Required for the plugin to work)

password.title: Password
password.description: The password used for your Wyze account (Required for the plugin to work)

key_id.title: Key Id
key_id.description: The Key Id that was generated for your Wyze account (Required for the plugin to work)

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: The Api Key that was generated for your Wyze account (Required for the plugin to work)

totpKey.title: 2FA authenticator seed (optional)
totpKey.description: Only if your Wyze account uses an authenticator app for two-factor authentication: the secret key shown when you set up the app (the text behind the QR code), not a 6-digit code. Used only when the plugin has to log in from scratch. SMS 2FA cannot be used by the plugin.

busyStatusCheckRefreshInterval.title: Busy status Check Refresh Interval
busyStatusCheckRefreshInterval.description: Seconds between status checks while the vacuum is cleaning, paused or returning to the dock. Default 45, minimum 25. Wyze may ignore requests if they come too often.

idleStatusCheck1RefreshInterval.title: Idle status Check Refresh Interval with full charge
idleStatusCheck1RefreshInterval.description: Seconds between status checks while the vacuum is docked with a full battery. Default 300 (5 min), minimum 300, maximum 3600. This is how quickly a run started outside the Home app (Wyze app, button, schedule) shows up.

idleStatusCheck2RefreshInterval.title: Idle status Check Refresh Interval with less than full charge
idleStatusCheck2RefreshInterval.description: Seconds between status checks while the vacuum is docked and charging. Default 60 (1 min), minimum 60.

pythonPath.title: Python interpreter
pythonPath.description: Python used to run the helpers, e.g. the python inside a virtual environment that has wyze-sdk installed (/opt/wyze-venv/bin/python). Default: python3

tokenFile.title: Token cache file
tokenFile.description: Where the Wyze access/refresh tokens are saved (created with owner-only permissions). Default: ~/.matterbridge/wyze-robovac/tokens.json
